root_causes: Existing source/artifact manifests and acquisition helpers cover part of provenance; the remaining gap is a tested cross-source operational contract and journal linking transformations and failures to immutable evidence, root-cause tests, remediation, and reruns.

findings: Acquisition integrity, schema/identity correctness, reference agreement, and model validity are separate claims and require separate evidence.
Different astronomical surveys must not be assumed to share feature semantics, cadence, units, selection functions, taxonomies, or label quality.
Existing evidence and source-subset manifests should be extended and reused; duplicating acquisition/hash infrastructure risks inconsistent provenance.
A failed or skipped stage must be recorded explicitly and cannot be treated as success.
Suspected causes remain hypotheses until a discriminating test verifies them.
Successful Gaia/TESS ingestion cannot resolve the CPVS membership discrepancy.
The initial journal assumes one writer per file; parallel workers must use separate journals or a later tested concurrency mechanism.

open_blockers: Validate the JSON run-manifest template and journal implementation through latest-head CI and add any needed schema/contract tests.
Review CodeQL, lifecycle gate, Scientific Validation, and Product Scope checks before merging PR #189.
Integrate journal events with existing EvidenceManifest and SourceSubsetManifest so each operation points to verified artifacts.
Run a bounded, pinned external-source pilot only after its query and schema contract are documented.
Verify source artifacts and outputs with SHA-256 and row/object accounting.
Keep CPVS exact reconstruction UNRESOLVED until its own evidence supports a different disposition.
